This is a case relating to the limit of iron filling as per order dated 02.11.2017 of the Director (RCD).
All States and Union Territories are directed not to launch prosecutions for non-conformance of limit of iron fillings in cases where samples were picked up/tested prior to 19.05.2016.
They are also advised to withdraw all such prosecutions launched prior to 19.05.2016 either under FSS Act, 2006 or PFA Act, 1954.
In this case, sample was drawn on 25.10.2014 and prosecution has been launched for non-conformance of iron fillings.
Matters being so, prosecution in this case will not lie in view of the aforesaid order dated 02.11.2017.
In the result, this Crl.M.C. is allowed, and all further proceedings against the petitioner in C.C.No.2091/2015 of the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court, Chavakkad, are hereby quashed.
